name: Rouge ~Manatsu no Kuchibeni~
source:
Protagonist's father dies and leaves the will for his son to take care of his secret daughter Eriko in Yokohama or get stripped from inheritance. The hero sets off to Yokohama while having only the picture of the girl.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的父亲去世后，在遗嘱中命令儿子前往横滨照顾自己不为人知的女儿绘里子，否则便剥夺其继承权。主人公手中只有女孩的一张照片，就这样动身前往横滨。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
